name: Unidentified OOM-series security droid (trapped)
description: A OOM-series security droid was a member of a Separatist crew that operated on the planet Loradil during the New Republic Era after their Providence-class carrier was shot down. Around 6 ABY, the OOM-series security droid and other battle droids attempted to steal the blaster being utilized by the human Han Solo, only to be destroyed by him moments later.
